method: One serial frozen1.0/current1.1 Heart of the Swarm production mission per build, default2x via public speed control, earned-credit Asteroid-only formation and public early calls. All-unlocked storage is navigation setup. No simulation objects, spawns, money or clock edits. Native rAF intervals include whole app/control/screenshot overhead, not pure GPU/Scene time. Dense subset requires publicly displayed >=20 hostiles after final wave; not a50-unit synthetic fixture. Heap points have uncontrolled GC and cannot establish a memory saving/leak result. Single-run observations are descriptive, not a rendering speedup claim.
